_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-1 inputs. L1 is statistical/type-based: only classification strings/scalars, no planform dimensions (those first appear at L2). Read by F16GeomL1 (.geometry) and F16AeroL1 (.aerodynamics).

geometry._src: aircraft_category selects Roskam Vol. I Table 3.5 (S_wet) / Raymer 6th Table 6.3 (L_fus) / Raymer 7th Table 4.1 (AR_eq, dogfighter row) regressions. M_max = Brandt Main-tab aircraft.Mmax.

aerodynamics._src: aircraft_type selects the fighter Roskam CLmax row + the Mattingly fighter curves. design_type='uncambered' sets K2=0 (Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Sec. 2.3.1). curve selects the 'Current' technology arrays (Mattingly Figs. 2.10/2.11).

cd0_curve._comment: PLACEHOLDER Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Fig. 2.10 CD0(M), fighter. From 5 AAF worked points (mattingly_data.md PART 9); TODO replace with the digitized figure. Future = copy of Current (no Future curve in repo).

k1_curve._comment: PLACEHOLDER Mattingly AED 2nd ed. Fig. 2.11 K1(M), fighter. From 5 AAF worked points (mattingly_data.md PART 9); TODO replace with the digitized figure. Future = copy of Current (no Future curve in repo).

propulsion._src: Brandt-F16-A.xls Engn(s) tab (T_AB_SLS) = Main!D29; T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I. Per examples/F16A/F16PropL1.md, F16PropL1 reads only engine_type + AB (max) SLS thrust; the L1 lapse exponent (Martins metabook Eq. 10.9) and TSFC table (Raymer 6th ed. Table 3.3) are selected by engine_type, not stored here.
propulsion._T_SL_source: AB (max) SLS thrust, lbf. Brandt Engn!T_AB_SLS = Main!D29 = 23770; T.O. 1F-16A-1 Sec. I. T_SL_wet is the AB alias of T_SL.
propulsion._engine_type_note: Engine-class identifier (F100-PW-200 class). Selects the PropL1 density-lapse exponent (turbofan m=0.6, Martins metabook Eq. 10.9) and the TSFC table rows (Raymer 6th ed. Table 3.3, low-bypass turbofan). Not a numeric design variable.

weights._comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Level-1 weight-estimation inputs (statistical empty-weight regressions: Raymer 6th ed. Table 3.1 power law + Roskam Part I Table 2.15 minimum-empty bound). Read by F16WeightsL1. L1 has NO geometry inputs. All regression coefficients are category-selected Constants inside the WeightsL1 toolbox (NOT JSON inputs; see _formula_constants_note). Edition/table drift (6th-vs-7th, Table 3.1-vs-6.1) is logged in VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md 2026-07-24 §3c.
weights._formula_constants_note: The Raymer Table 3.1 power-law coefficients (jet_fighter A=2.34, C=-0.13, Kvs=1.00) and the Roskam Part I Table 2.15 coefficients (A=0.5091, B=0.9505) are NOT JSON inputs -- they are Constants selected by aircraft_category inside the WeightsL1 toolbox (mirroring the propulsion lookup_TSFC_coeffs precedent).
weights._aircraft_category_source: Selects the Raymer Table 3.1 / Roskam Table 2.15 jet_fighter regression rows. Matches F16WeightsL1 default.
weights._W_payload_fixed_source: Fixed equipment + crew, lbf. [estimate: 1 pilot + survival gear -- NOT pinned to a repo source; flagged in F16WeightsL1.md Deviations].
weights._W_payload_expendable_source: Expendable payload, lbf; set by mission profile. [WeightsBase contract].
